verdict.rationale: Checkout.com has no documented automation or background-agent feature. What it offers are building blocks: webhooks that automatically notify your server of payment, balance and dispute events (including delivery to Amazon EventBridge), configurable risk rules that apply to payments without manual action, and AI-driven automatic payment optimization. The MCP server is interactive and IDE-driven, not a scheduled or background agent, so any autonomous automation has to be built on the merchant's own infrastructure. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation/workflow builder, scheduled or background agent runs, autonomous agent execution beyond IDE-driven MCP use, and independent corroboration.
